title: Import wizard: the mapping-template "Save current" button is disabled with no reason on hover, on focus or to assistive technology
body:
qa#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUARzLeR7GhKms8a5s

QA-source: #31486 · ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason · acceptance[0]

The failing clause of `ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason` in the QA run #31486 (subject `0647dabb`), rule R-3 there. Reproduced on 2 fresh loads.

## Reproduction (stock showcase, admin)

1. `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task` → Import.
2. Upload a CSV whose columns match no field, e.g. `foo,bar` / `x,1` / `y,2`.
3. Mapping step: leave both columns Skip.
4. Find `[data-testid=import-template-save-btn]` ("Save current", inside `[data-testid=import-template-bar]`).

Expected: the disabled control shows why on hover, and is reachable by keyboard with an accessible description (e.g. "Map at least one column to save a template").

Actual: the button carries the native `disabled` attribute; no `[role=tooltip]` after a 1.5 s hover; no `aria-describedby`, no `title`, no focusable wrapper; Tab skips it (template select → mapping selects → Cancel → Back → Next → Close). The Next button on the same step passes (focusable wrapper plus a described reason), so this is not a driver artifact.

## Mechanism

`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx`: `TemplateBar` renders the Button with `disabled={disabled}` and `data-testid="import-template-save-btn"` (around lines 1520–1531) and no disabled-reason wrapper; the caller passes `disabled={Object.keys(mapping).length === 0}` (around line 1730).

Owning package: `@object-ui/plugin-grid`. Full evidence: #31486, slice C3b.
